Canadian Laboratory Suppliers Directory

LabDirectory Canada is the independent directory of laboratory equipment suppliers, scientific supplies distributors, research reagent vendors and biotechnology service companies serving research laboratories across Canada. Universities, hospital laboratories, contract research organizations and biotech startups use the directory to locate Canadian suppliers of analytical instruments, chromatography consumables, HPLC columns, mass spectrometry services, cell culture media, lab reagents and research chemicals.

Browse by category

  • Laboratory equipment — balances, centrifuges, incubators, chromatography systems
  • Scientific supplies and reagents — research reagents, peptides, antibodies, buffers, solvents
  • Biotechnology services — sequencing, assay development, contract research
  • Laboratory services — calibration, analytical testing, certificate of analysis documentation

Featured suppliers in Ontario and British Columbia

Recently listed laboratory suppliers include Northern Lab Supply (Toronto), Pacific Reagents (Vancouver), Prairie Scientific (Calgary) and Maritime Biotech (Halifax). Each listing includes contact details, product lines and a link to the supplier's website.

Why list your laboratory business

Listings are free for Canadian laboratory suppliers. A listing includes your company description, website link, categories, service area and contact information. Our editorial team reviews every submission within five business days to keep the directory accurate and useful for the Canadian scientific community. We do not accept listings from companies outside the laboratory and life sciences sector.

Updated October 20, 2026. Subscribe to our monthly newsletter for new supplier announcements and laboratory procurement tips.

About the directory

Founded in 2012 by laboratory managers in Toronto, LabDirectory Canada is maintained by a small editorial team with backgrounds in analytical chemistry and biochemistry. The directory is funded by optional premium listings and never by paid links. Read our about page, editorial policy and privacy policy.
